units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:7">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הט׳ מוצע לכם</he> the banqueting couch is spread for you (your reward in the hereafter is prepared).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 4:2:3">Y. R. Hash. IV, 59ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אפ׳ מט׳ לקיטון</he> even if they adjourned from the tricl. to the sleeping room.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:7:2">Y. Keth. IV, 28ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:6:4">Y. Snh. XI, end, 30ᶜ</cite> [read:] <he>בעיא הדא אומנתא ט׳ וקיטין חופה וקיטון וכ׳</he> the following construction is required (in order to make the reception of the bride in the triclinium a legal consummation of marriage) a tricl. and a marriage chamber, and that chamber communicating with the tricl.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:18">Tosef. Sabb. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:18">XVII</cite>), 18 <he>ט׳ שהסיקה … בה</he> in a banqueting room (triclinium hibernum) which has been heated a day before …, you may entertain company on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:10">Tosef. Bets. II, 10</cite> <he>ט׳ שהסיקוהו וכ׳</he>; a. e.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:3:2">Y. Sot. V, 20ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>איטלק עלוי חד ט׳ וכ׳</he> he was fined to fill a granary of forty by forty &c.
